input.title: Smooth Flexbox Filtering with Flip (GreenSock CodePen NWRxarv)
input.technique: FLIP (First-Last-Invert-Play) reflow animation. Capture the bounding-box state of every card BEFORE the filter mutation, mutate the DOM (toggle each card's display between "inline-flex" and "none" so flexbox reflows the visible set), then call Flip.from(state, ...). Flip diffs the new positions/sizes against the snapshot, instantly inverts every visible card back to its old spot, and animates the removal of those offsets so cards slide into their new flex slots. onEnter handles items that re-entered the flow (fade+scale in), onLeave handles items that left (fade+scale out), with absolute:true holding leavers in their old slot during the tween so the surviving cards don't fight a layout shift mid-animation.
input.keyMechanic: Three-step lifecycle on every checkbox click: (1) state = Flip.getState(items) snapshots all 8 .item rects; (2) items.forEach(item => item.style.display = matches.indexOf(item) === -1 ? "none" : "inline-flex") — this is what makes flexbox re-pack the visible cards into a tight grid; (3) Flip.from(state, { duration: 0.7, scale: true, ease: "power1.inOut", stagger: 0.08, absolute: true, onEnter: els => gsap.fromTo(els,{opacity:0,scale:0},{opacity:1,scale:1,duration:1}), onLeave: els => gsap.to(els,{opacity:0,scale:0,duration:1}) }) tweens everything. absolute:true is the load-bearing option — it lifts the leaving cards to position:absolute for the duration of the flip so the staying cards can flow into their new flex positions without their tween being clobbered by the same reflow.
input.a11yNotes: prefers-reduced-motion: gate the entire Flip.from call (set duration:0 or skip the tween) when window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches — the demo doesn't do this. Focus management: the demo toggles display:none on items, which removes them from the tab order automatically (correct). For Lucifer's Diary, ensure focus doesn't get stranded on a card that's mid-fade-out — move focus back to the clicked tag button after navigation. Announce filter results to screen readers via an aria-live="polite" region ("Showing 24 of 87 stories") since the visual reflow is silent. Tag buttons in the demo are <input type="checkbox"> inside <label> — keep that semantic (or use role="button" with aria-pressed) so toggling state is announced; the current TagBar uses <Link> which announces as navigation rather than toggle — fine for SSR-driven filtering but worth knowing if you switch to client-side. While Flip is animating, the cards have position:absolute applied transiently — pointer-events on leaving cards should be disabled so a user can't click a card that's flying off-screen. Stagger of 0.08s feels lively but compounds: with 50+ visible cards the last one is 4s behind the first — cap stagger to {amount: 0.4} (total budget) rather than per-item for large grids.
